data.standardized_narrative: During 2015 the syndicate experienced an overall adverse prior years development of GBP 1.776m (gross) - a net strengthening of reserves - driven primarily by deterioration of GBP 3.356m in the fire and other damage to property account, partially offset by improvements of GBP 1.275m in marine, aviation and transport and GBP 0.344m in reinsurance acceptances. The movements were influenced by a number of larger losses (notably earlier-year events impacting the 2013 year such as the Blue Racer vapour cloud explosion, the Julius Klein theft and a turbine damage claim) and by adverse development in specific property/utility accounts.
